description.narrative: The Social Protection for Gender Empowerment Program aims to strengthen policy, coordination, systems, and capacity through integrated capacity building, leveraging innovation and digital solutions to enhance social protection and mitigation strategies. The program focuses on establishing a robust accountability and coordination system, ensuring sustainable and shock-sensitive social protection financing for adaptation and resilience. Additionally, it prioritizes evidence generation and learning; local governance and decentralization for social sectors including reproductive, maternal, newborn, and child health services. The program objectives also include resilience and livelihood enhancements, improving access to social services such as education, health, and well-being initiatives, poverty alleviation initiatives, and hunger alleviation programs, and ultimately promoting gender equality and empowerment through comprehensive social protection measures.
